title: FIT_TO_SHARED_EDGE payload
description: Weld two open boundary edges into one shared edge; the leading plane is fixed (v0.2 C.8; spec §10.5). Tolerance and strategy are required: without them the source asks for a diagnostic error (INVALID_PAYLOAD).

edgeIds.description: The two open boundary half-edges (twinId = null), on faces A and B.

leadingFaceId.description: Face A; its plane does not change (GT-06).

maxDisplacementM.description: Maximum displacement allowed. No default: the sources give none (Q-20); 3D-06 proposes "always explicit".

movableFaceIds.description: The priority strategy: planes that may move; empty = B fixed (spec §10.5 rule 4). Must not contain leadingFaceId.

$comment: [P] Field names; the strategy written as a movable-face list.
